tours.name: Required Fields on a New Department

name_i18n.en_US: Required Fields on a New Department

tours.description: Learn what happens when you save a department without a name.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn what happens when you save a department without a name.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: Departments are managed in the Employees app.

description_i18n.en_US: Departments are managed in the Employees app.

steps.title: Departments
steps.description: Every department is shown as a card.

description_i18n.en_US: Every department is shown as a card.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to start a department.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to start a department.

steps.description: The form opens empty. Leave the required fields empty on purpose to see how Odoo protects the data.

description_i18n.en_US: The form opens empty. Leave the required fields empty on purpose to see how Odoo protects the data.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon without filling anything in.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon without filling anything in.

steps.description: Odoo checks the required fields when you save. A record with a required field left empty can never be stored.

description_i18n.en_US: Odoo checks the required fields when you save. A record with a required field left empty can never be stored.

steps.title: Read the message
steps.content: Read the red message. Click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Read the red message. Click it to continue.

steps.description: The department name is the only required field, so the message names it. Every department needs a name so people can recognise it in lists and reports.

description_i18n.en_US: The department name is the only required field, so the message names it. Every department needs a name so people can recognise it in lists and reports.

steps.title: Discard
steps.content: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

steps.description: Nothing was stored. The red outline on the field shows what is missing. Fill it in and save again to create a real department.

description_i18n.en_US: Nothing was stored. The red outline on the field shows what is missing. Fill it in and save again to create a real department.
